rows.grounds: compound noun in apposition with karaṃ

items.question: By whom is the all-accomplishment of all said to be made?
premises: accomplishment is attributed to the wise
items.inference: wise practitioners are presented as agents of universal accomplishment
uncertainties: exact syntactic relation between sarvasiddhi and karaṃ is unclear from tokenization
items.plain_english: By the wise, [this is] the maker of all accomplishment for all.
